units.source_text: 实在是个十分明了的定义。

en.t: It is indeed a very clear definition.

units.source_text: 总之，所谓沙子就是碎岩石中，介于小石子和黏土的中间物质。

en.t: In short, what is called sand is the substance among broken rock that lies between small stones and clay.

units.source_text: 可是，单纯用中间物质来说明，实在很难说这解释是完整的。

en.t: But if it is explained simply as an intermediate substance, it is hard to say that the explanation is complete.

units.source_text: 石子、沙子和黏土三样东西，在复杂混合的泥土之中，

en.t: Pebbles, sand, and clay, within the complex mixture of soil,

units.source_text: 为什么只有沙子被特别地分出来，成为独立的沙漠或沙地呢？

en.t: why is only sand specially separated out and made into independent deserts or sandy ground?

units.source_text: 假如是单纯的中间物质，那么，风化和水的侵蚀，

en.t: If it were merely an intermediate substance, then weathering and erosion by water

units.source_text: 在岩石表面和黏土地带之间，应该形成无数过渡的中间层次才对。

en.t: ought to form countless transitional middle layers between rock surfaces and clay zones.

units.source_text: 然而，现实中所存在的，却是石头、沙子、黏土三种能够清清楚楚区别开来的外观。

en.t: Yet what exists in reality is the clearly distinguishable appearance of three kinds: stone, sand, and clay.

units.source_text: 更奇妙的是，只要是沙子，那么，

en.t: What is stranger still is that, as long as it is sand,

units.source_text: 江之岛海岸的沙子也好，戈壁大沙漠的沙子也好，

en.t: whether it is sand from the coast of Enoshima or sand from the great Gobi Desert,

units.source_text: 不管那沙粒来自何方，它们颗粒的大小几乎没有差别，

en.t: no matter where those grains of sand come from, there is almost no difference in the size of their particles,

units.source_text: 几乎可以1/8mm为中心，描绘出一条十分接近于高斯误差的分布曲线。

en.t: and one can draw a distribution curve centered almost on 1/8 mm that is very close to a Gaussian error curve.
